description.en-US: Apps from the official F-Droid Archive that no longer install or run on current Android, rebuilt from their original source for modern phones. Source and build changes: https://github.com/PrinceGarth/archville

metadata.authorName: Russell Wolf (Android port), Pieter Spronck (original game)

summary.en-US: Trade, fight and smuggle your way across the galaxy (Palm OS classic)

description.en-US:
Space Trader is a port of the Palm OS game of the same name, created by Pieter
Spronck. A classic among Palm gamers of the era, it was named Freeware Game of
the Year by Handheld Computing in 2000.

This Android port faithfully reproduces the original game. Your goal
is to earn enough money, whether by honest trading or other, seedier means, to
retire to your own moon. Buy goods on one planet to sell to another, but watch
out for space pirates! If you're tough enough, hunt down pirates to earn rewards.
If that seems too above-board, try smuggling illegal items for spectacular profits.
Or, if you'd rather, become a pirate yourself and rob other traders of their goods.
Be careful, though. The police take notice of illegal activity...

'''About this build (F-Droid Archville)'''

The last release (1.3.5) was archived by F-Droid and targets Android 6.0, so
Android 15 and newer refuse to install it. This is the same game rebuilt
from the archived source for current Android: targets Android 16, uses
AndroidX, handles edge-to-edge display and the predictive back gesture.
Gameplay is unchanged.

Signed with the Archville key, not the original developer's key, so it
cannot update an existing install of the old version: uninstall that first
(saved games do not carry over).

Phones older than Android 5.0 should keep using the original APK from the
official F-Droid Archive repository.
